steps: In the signed-in Vault, expand the generator and confirm Password mode is selected.
Set length to 32; disable Uppercase, Digits, and Symbols; generate and reveal the candidate. Verify length and lowercase-only character class without recording the value.

Confirm Exclude ambiguous can be toggled on and off. Do not infer its character-set behavior from a single randomly generated password; the deterministic component test forces the same entropy sample through both states.
Regenerate, copy, clear, collapse, and reopen. Repeat the generation and clearing checks after extension reload.
expected: Length and enabled character groups affect the locally generated candidate; the source component test covers length and disabled groups.
Changing options, clearing, or collapsing removes the current candidate; reveal/copy behavior is covered by the existing component test.

The native step verifies that the Exclude ambiguous control is usable. Its alphabet behavior is covered deterministically by the component test; every-toggle combinations, warm/reload persistence, and OS clipboard results still require native verification.

steps: Choose Passphrase mode; set seven words and a space separator, turn on Capitalize and Append digit, then generate and reveal.
Verify seven capitalized words separated by spaces and one trailing digit without recording the value; copy it and confirm it remains local until Use.
Repeat with the dot separator; after extension reload, confirm the generator starts from its documented defaults unless product state is intentionally persisted.
expected: The configured word count, separator, capitalization, and appended digit determine the candidate; source tests cover space and dot separators.
Copy reports the app's clipboard result and does not submit or use the candidate; OS clipboard behavior and reload behavior require native verification.

steps: On a signed-in owned login page with two offered new-password targets, generate a candidate, select the second target in Choose password fields, and press Use.
Verify only the selected field receives the candidate and the page is not submitted; repeat after changing the page or removing the offered target before Use.
expected: The Use request carries the selected offer ID; a component test proves selection of the second offer reaches the request.
Only the selected live page field changes, no form submission occurs, and stale/unavailable targets produce a recoverable message; these outcomes need native verification.

steps: While signed out, inspect side-panel navigation and attempt to open Vault directly; repeat after extension reload.
Sign in and confirm Vault becomes reachable, distinguishing the guest restriction from an unavailable or failed Vault surface.
expected: Guests do not see the Vault tab or Vault content because the tab audience is signed-in; signed-in users can reach the Vault surface.
The side panel presents its normal signed-out path and does not expose the generator controls to guests; verify in the native side panel.

limitations: Component tests exercise the real PasswordGenerator and shared credential generator with only Chrome runtime, Supabase RPC, clipboard function, and page field discovery represented as external boundaries.
These tests do not verify authentication, organization authorization, native Chrome extension surfaces, real page field filling, reload behavior, or OS clipboard contents.
No product source, inventory case, authorization path, or secret-access path was changed or exercised.
